summary.text: Kenny Nguyen, a Democrat, represents District 33 (Adams, Broomfield and Weld counties) in the Colorado House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: He took office in January 2026, succeeding William Lindstedt, and is a candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was born in Boulder, Colorado, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Colorado Boulder in 2016 and a graduate degree from the University of Colorado Denver in 2024.
His career experience includes working in government.
